title: Werkstudent Customer Success (x/f/m)
description:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Doctolib sucht Dich ab sofort als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Customer Success für unseren Standort in Berlin. 

Das Customer Success Team bei Doctolib ist verantwortlich für die allgemeine Kundenzufriedenheit und eine langfristig erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit mit kleinen bis mittelgroßen Praxen. Wir begleiten unsere Kund:innen im Alltag, unterstützen sie bei der optimalen Nutzung unserer digitalen Lösungen und stehen ihnen bei Fragen oder Herausforderungen zuverlässig zur Seite. Wir tragen dazu bei, dass Praxen das volle Potenzial von Doctolib ausschöpfen können und so gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens gestalten.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

  • Du koordinierst interne Aufgaben, indem du eingehende Anfragen auf das Team verteilst und für einen guten Informationsfluss sorgst
  • Du stehst im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kund:innen – sowohl schriftlich als auch telefonisch – bearbeitest deren Anliegen, begleitest strukturelle Änderungen und informierst proaktiv über Produktneuheiten oder zusätzliche Angebote
  • Du unterstützt das Team und die Teamleitung bei administrativen Prozessen und sorgst dafür, dass der Arbeitsalltag reibungslos läuft
  • Du bringst dich aktiv in Projekte zur internen Prozessoptimierung ein und unterstützt bei der Dokumentation sowie Aufbereitung von Lerninhalten für das Team

Während Deiner Tätigkeit bei uns wirst Du lernen:

  • Den Aufbau einer Customer Success Organisation kennenlernen und Verständnis für die Customer Journey von Kunden im SaaS-Umfeld entwickeln
  • Lernen, Prozesse zu analysieren und fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit der Bearbeitung von Tickets im CRM-System Salesforce erwerben
  • Verständnis entwickeln, wie nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und Kundenzufriedenheit langfristig gesichert werden

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Du bist in Vollzeit an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert
  • Du interessierst Dich für den Bereich Digitalisierung, insbesondere im Gesundheitswesen, und bringst Deine kommunikative Art gerne in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden ein
  • Du hast Freude an administrativen Tätigkeiten, arbeitest gerne lösungs- und detailorientiert und bringst technische Affinität mit
  • Du verfügst über eine selbständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise und hast Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Du hast bereits in der Kundenbetreuung  oder im Sales gearbeitet
  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung in einer SaaS Firma oder im Gesundheitswesen gesammelt

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein strukturiertes und individuelles Onboarding im Rahmen unserer Doctolib Academy sowie ein breites Angebot an internen Trainingsprogrammen
  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder die Übernahme Deines Semestertickets
  • 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr (anteilig auf Deine Arbeitszeiten berechnet)
  • Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten (nach 6 Monaten)
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit vielen Zusatzleistungen und Bezuschussungen (nach 6 Monaten)
  • Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, das hybrides und Office-basiertes Arbeiten ermöglicht
  • Regelmäßige Frühstücksangebote im Büro sowie Bezuschussungen zu Deinem Lebensmitteleinkauf
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

Der Interview-Prozess

  • Interview mit Deiner Managerin (60´) 
  • Offer

Job Details

  • Tätigkeit als Werkstudent:in (20 Std./Woche)
  • Tätigkeitsdauer: min. 1 Jahr
  • Arbeitsort: Berlin
  • Gehalt: 15 €/Std.
  • Startdatum: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Arbeitsmodus: Hybrid (3 Tage Office/Woche)

 

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.
Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.
Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als (Senior) Key Account Success Manager:in als Unterstützung für das Hospital Success Team in Berlin.
Im Hospital Success Team betreust Du einen festen Kundenstamm aus Kliniken und Krankenhäusern und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum des Teams bei. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Kund:innen – auf Augenhöhe mit Entscheider:innen – und entwickelst Accounts strategisch weiter. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Sales, Deployment und Technical Project Management zusammen, um Deinen Kund:innen den bestmöglichen Erfolg mit Doctolib zu ermöglichen.

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)

Language requirement: fluency in German or Spanish

Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend

 

About the role: 

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

 

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

  • Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
  • Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
  • Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
  • Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis

  • Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
  • Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
  • Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design

  • Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
  • Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
  • Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
  • Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling

  • Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
  • Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
  • Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
  • Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting

  • Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
  • Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

 

About You:

Essential

  • 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
  • A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
  • Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
  • A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
  • Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
  • Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
  • Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable

  • Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
  • Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
  • Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

 

What Success Looks Like:

  • Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
  • Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
  • Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
  • Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

title: Test Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

thinkcell provides graphics software that performs most of the painstaking work of creating data-driven slides for professional Excel and PowerPoint users. The testing department makes sure that new features are technically sound and work reliably for all user groups, from new users to seasoned financial professionals. 

 

What you will do 

As a Test Engineer at thinkcell, you'll help improve a product that over 1,000,000 professionals around the world rely on every day.

Testing and verifying new features is an important part of the job, as our product continues to evolve. Since think-cell is seamlessly integrated into Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, we must pay close attention to its compatibility with supported Microsoft Office versions, operating systems, and their respective updates.

There is a certain level of complexity to our product and consequently to the testing process. Problem-solving skills are important as well as keeping an overview between verifying fixes, creating test cases, and ensuring our users receive only top quality. 

 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Feature Testing: Ensure new think-cell features work properly and verify their logical consistency and usability. 
  • Release Testing: Conduct final quality checks before each think-cell version release. 
  • Error Reproduction and Reporting: Create detailed error reproductions and document them clearly. Provide precise information to help resolve issues and record all error-related details in the internal system. 
  • Verification: Verify that developer fixes successfully resolve reported issues. 
  • Knowledge Base Management: Maintain and expand the internal Knowledge Base with documentation of new product functionality. 

 
 You will be great for this position if you have 

  • High level of self-motivation and independent work structuring. 
  • Curiosity and critical thinking. 
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies. 
  • Fluency in written and spoken English. 
  • (Plus) Experience with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel. 

 
 Our Values 

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us: 

  • Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo. 
  • Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes. 
  • Customer First: We prioritize delivering lasting value. 
  • Unified Team: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity. 
  • Strive for Excellence: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality. 

 
 Why is thinkcell the right place for you? 

We empower over 1.2 million users across 30,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 150 people, committed to innovation and excellence. 

Think-cell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

title: Consultant
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP. About the role For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits. Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own. That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams. You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself. You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate. What you'll do Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates. Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker. Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it. Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide. Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach. Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all. Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with our engineering teams. Collaborate with Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and with the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made. For customers without a Customer Success Manager, act as the escalation point for SLA breaches and own continuity of operations. Direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts. What we're really looking for The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Process Excellence – You understand core business processes deeply, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead. Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not, you understand the context people are working in, and you have more than one way of convincing them. Ownership & Autonomy – You take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps. Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.   • Proven track record of managing lengthy or complex enterprise sales cycles

  • Significant experience selling directly to C-level executives (CxOs) and multi-threading within large enterprise organizations

  • Clear understanding of, and practical experience with, consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDPIC, SPIN, Challenger)

  • 4-year university degree (bachelor's)

  • Exceptional business communication skills, enabling you to execute executive storytelling, challenge the status quo, and handle complex contracting negotiations

  • High learning agility, analytical thinking, and commercial curiosity to quickly grasp the nuances of various corporate industries

  • High AI fluency and advanced CRM tracking skills

  • Native-level proficiency in German with professional English level (C1+)

title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Integrations)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market-access and integration efforts. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline. You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs). The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy. You will join a team, based in Manchester, that is innovative and engineering-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. 🚀 What you'll own Market Access & Prequalification: Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) into German ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and Redispatch 3.0. Support prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO and ensure our telemetry and control approach satisfies TSO-specific and BNetzA requirements for market participation. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; your focus is enabling market access, telemetry, and dispatch.) Integration Technology (your core deliverable): Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits. Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit. Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues. Hardware & On-site Support (occasional): Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to Kraken’s Berlin office and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English , essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field ( or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration). Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control). Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering. German market knowledge: TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process. Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements. Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework. Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams. Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK. ⭐️ Bonus points Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus , or similar IEC protocols. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector ( NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness ; IEC 62443 a plus). Familiarity with CLI tools for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux-based environments. Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling. Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. Waniwani builds the infrastructure that distributes insurance and banking products through AI assistants. We raised an $8M seed led by Seedcamp and work with large European banks and insurers. Each enterprise deal has to be scoped, architected, and deployed into a regulated environment. This role owns the layer between a signed deal and a live deployment.

The role

  • Customer workshops, discovery, and requirements (35%). Run technical discovery and workshops with each client, and translate their needs into clear, buildable product requirements for our sales, ops, and engineering teams. Flag what we need to build to support a given setup, such as client self-hosting.

  • Solution architecture and documentation (35%). Design the end-to-end MCP flow and integration architecture for each client, including hosted versus on-premise scenarios, and produce the technical documentation enterprise clients require (BPI France alone is roughly 50 docs).

  • Procurement, security, and delivery oversight (30%). Use our existing compliance library (SOC 2 program, DPAs, prior questionnaire answers) to complete security questionnaires, handle security committees and data-residency questions, and drive procurement to completion. Oversee the MCP deployment itself, which our freelancer network implements.

Across all three, you build the reusable kit that makes this repeatable: scoping templates, architecture patterns, and a procurement answer library.

Objectives

  • 90 days: own scoping and procurement response for active deals, with the reusable kit used on at least one live deal end to end.

  • 6 months: run the full signed-to-live pipeline, including architecture decisions and procurement ownership, without founders in the critical path.

  • 12 months: a repeatable delivery process with patterns reused across clients, and a case for the first hire under this role.

Requirements

  • You are technically credible: you read code, reason fluently about integrations and the MCP and agent stack, and can scope and oversee a deployment. This is not a hands-on production-coding role; implementation is handled by our freelancer network.

  • You are comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise clients.

  • You can drive a security questionnaire or procurement process to completion from existing documentation.

  • You have worked in or near regulated industries (finance, insurance) and understand compliance and data residency requirements.

  • You work well in ambiguity across sales, ops, and engineering, and ramp into new domains quickly.

  • You have an interest in the MCP and agent stack.

  • You are open to traveling from time to time across Europe and the US to meet clients.

What this role is not

  • A backend engineering role. You will work with clients most of the week.

  • A pure pre-sales role. You own architecture, requirements, and delivery oversight, not only the pitch.

  • A slideware role. You need real technical depth, even though you are not writing production code day to day.

Practicalities

  • Remote-first, based in Europe. Expect travel roughly once a month, primarily Paris, London, and Madrid, with US travel around the 6-month mark. Being able to come to Paris occasionally is a plus but not required.

  • First hire in this function, working directly with the founders and the engineering team.

Process

  • Intro call with our talent partner.

  • 30-minute conversation with Max, our CTO.

  • Work sample based on a real client scenario (live session): scope the flow, draft the architecture, and handle a mock procurement Q&A.

  • Discussions with Robin, our CEO, Luiza, and members of the tech team.

  • Reference checks.

We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

What You'll Own

  • The website, GEO, and the acquisition funnel, for the Career Professionals (individual, B2P) and Self Serve Employers (under 250 employees, under roughly $20,000 a year, no salesperson) segments specifically.

  • Self-serve conversion, from first visit through signup, upgrade, and, eventually, the point where an account outgrows self-serve and hands off to the Assisted tier.

  • The B2P and SMB messaging, in practice, not just in the shared Messaging Framework, this is the one seat that gets to see directly whether that messaging actually converts.


What Success Looks Like

  • A defensible, evidence-backed answer to the LTV:CAC question this seat's own existence is gated on.

  • A written, documented Critical User Journey for the self-serve signup and upgrade path, which currently doesn't exist anywhere in the registry, despite being arguably the easiest journey in the company to document precisely, since nobody has to be interviewed to understand it.

  • Growth in self-serve revenue that either justifies this becoming a permanent Senior PM seat, or, just as validly, a clear, honest case that it shouldn't.


What We're Looking For

  • Real self-serve growth experience.Funnel optimization, conversion, GEO, and a track record of moving a number without a sales team's help.

  • Comfort being precise about what the product actually does.The current messaging pillar "one system, individual to enterprise" is accurate for the core learner product but not for Command, since Self Serve Employers get no Command at all. You'll need to hold that distinction in your own funnel copy rather than overclaim it.

  • A bias toward writing things down.This seat starts with more open whitespace, no CUJ, no dedicated pod, than almost any other seat in the org, and the person who takes it will be building the paper trail as much as the funnel.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

raw.description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

The role

You'll be a senior engineer on the RA Guide iOS app: shaping how it's built, leading the technical design of larger features, and raising the bar on quality with the Apps lead.

RA Guide is RA's app for browsing events and buying tickets, native on iOS and Android and used by thousands of people every day. We also make RA Scan, a cross-platform app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll join the Apps team: the Apps lead (who also builds on iOS), an Android developer and a product manager, working closely with design and the web teams who build the APIs the app uses.

We release weekly. Native releases can't be rolled back once they're out, so we care about getting each one right: tests, careful review, and watching what happens after release.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design of larger features, including the specs that line up iOS and Android on the same APIs
  • Own areas of the codebase, and modernise older parts of it safely
  • Raise release quality: automated UI tests on native frameworks, crash analysis and monitoring
  • Review code and mentor other developers
  • Work with the web and platform teams on the APIs the app depends on
  • Help shape how the team uses AI in development, and where it shouldn't.

Who we are looking for

  • Several years building and releasing iOS apps used at scale
  • Deep experience with Swift, app architecture and refactoring code that's already live
  • Testing and coding habits for stable app releases
  • You make the developers around you better, through review, pairing and clear explanation
  • You can explain a technical trade-off to product and design in plain terms

If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. We'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have

  • SwiftUI, reactive programming and GraphQL
  • A/B testing, phased rollouts and data tracking
  • Monitoring tools such as Datadog
  • Android or cross-platform experience
  • An interest in electronic music and the scenes RA serves

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

This role is a full-time based in our Berlin office. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €70,000- €85,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact

raw.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
  • Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
  • AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
  • Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
  • Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
  • Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine*n berufserfahrene*n Senior Consultant für die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsstellen-, Monitoring- und Berichtsformaten im Bereich Forschung und Innovation. Ihr Arbeitsschwerpunkt liegt auf der Koordination, fachlich-redaktionellen Steuerung und Mitarbeit bei der konzeptionellen Fortentwicklung solcher Formate für öffentliche Auftraggeber*innen. Sie bringen ein fundiertes Verständnis der deutschen Forschungs- und Innovationslandschaft mit und haben Freude daran, komplexe Sachverhalte adressatengerecht aufzubereiten und weiterzuentwickeln. Ihre Aufgaben Kontinuierliche Beobachtung und Analyse forschungs- und innovationspolitischer Entwicklungen und deren Aufbereitung für wiederkehrende Berichts-, Monitoring- und Beratungsformate öffentlicher Auftraggeber*innen Aufbereitung, Vermittlung und visuelle Darstellung statistischer Daten sowie von Indikatoren zum Forschungs- und Innovationssystem Erstellung, inhaltlich-redaktionelle Koordination und Qualitätssicherung adressatengerechter Berichte, Studien und Präsentationen für ein Fachpublikum sowie die breite Öffentlichkeit – von der Konzeption über die eigenständige empirische Arbeit bis zur finalen Abstimmung mit allen Beteiligten Projektmanagement, inkl. Zeit- und Ressourcenplanung innerhalb des Teams, Steuerung von Abstimmungs- und Schnittstellenprozessen mit Auftraggeber*innen und Kooperationspartner*innen Ihr Profil Mindestens vier Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Politikberatung und/oder Evaluation, Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projektteams und Wahrnehmung von Geschäftsstellenaufgaben wünschenswert Erfahrung in der Akquise von Beratungs- und Auftragsforschungsprojekten für Organisationen in unserem Arbeitsumfeld Erfahrung in der Steuerung von komplexen Abstimmungsprozessen mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern aus dem Wissenschaftskontext, bspw. Bundes- und Landesministerien oder Wissenschaftsorganisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der deutschen Forschungs- und Innovationslandschaft sowie aktueller forschungs- und innovationspolitischer Debatten Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftsbasierter Berichte sowie in der Aufbereitung und Vermittlung statistischer Daten im Bereich Forschung und Innovation; Kenntnisse in Innovationsindikatorik und Wissenschaftsstatistik von Vorteil Ausgeprägte redaktionelle und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht, klar und ausgewogen aufzubereiten Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Fachgebiet, belastbare empirische Methodenkenntnisse; Selbständigkeit sowie eine analytische, verbindliche und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen (z. T. auch internationalen) Dienstreisen; sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil Unser Angebot Wir bieten durch die enge Projektzusammenarbeit mit öffentlichen Institutionen ein sinnstiftendes und gesellschaftlich wirkungsvolles Arbeitsumfeld. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Anstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Zuschüsse zur Nutzung umweltfreundlicher Mobilitätsarten (ÖPNV oder Jobrad), für eine Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft sowie die betriebliche Altersversorgung runden das Angebot ab. Wir ermöglichen eine flexible Arbeitsweise mit attraktiven Arbeitsplätzen sowie Home-Office-Möglichkeiten durch mobilfähige Ausstattung (MacBook & iPhone). Als innovatives Unternehmen fördern wir die Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden über interne und externe Fortbildungsangebote. Wir fördern Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative für den Ausbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Aktivitäten durch flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Wir legen Wert auf eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und leben dies z.B. durch ein kollegiales, vertrauensvolles Miteinander, aber auch z.B. regelmäßige Teamevents, inkl. Events aller Kolleg*innen der Technopolis-Büros weltweit. Wir pflegen den Austausch mit unseren Schwesterbüros in Europa, Afrika und Lateinamerika. Technopolis ist ausschließlich in Besitz der Mitarbeitenden , externe Investore*innen gibt es bei uns nicht. Perspektivisch können alle Mitarbeitende Anteilseigner*innen der Technopolis Group werden. Unabhängig hiervon partizipiert unser gesamtes Team regelmäßig am Unternehmenserfolg. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen, bewerben Sie sich gerne. Vielleicht sind genau Sie die richtige Person für diese Stelle. Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Weiteres Verfahren Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Bitte laden Sie Ihre deutschsprachige Bewerbung (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf ohne Foto, relevante Zeugnisse sowie eine Textprobe) auf unserer Webseite unter Angabe Ihrer Standortpräferenz und Gehaltsvorstellung sowie Wunscharbeitszeit und frühestmöglichen Einstiegsdatum hoch. Für Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an unsere Recruiting Assistentin Susann Reinsch (susann.reinsch_AT_technopolis-group.com). Bewerbungsschluss ist der 30. September 2026. We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI. We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it Turn the data into something users act on Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway Own the numbers Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you What we are looking for You might be a fit if: You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. This is the requirement we're least flexible on You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. Strong plus if you have: PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale Subscription and paywall experimentation Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers Your own portfolio, and opinions about it If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess. Work authorisation This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations. What the first six months look like Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy. Why join getquin? Why join getquin? We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account.   • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

description: Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials. As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank's expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank's representative within a highly specialized industry. Success in this role requires credibility, confidence, and the ability to build long-term relationships with senior leaders across Europe and North America. You understand the business, speak the language of the industry, and know how to create value beyond the transaction. This is a senior, external-facing role for someone who has spent their career within the mobility interiors ecosystem. You thrive in face-to-face conversations, industry events, customer visits, and executive meetings, knowing that lasting partnerships are built through trust and personal relationships. The role is Europe-based and requires extensive international travel (approximately 80–90%) across Europe and North America, with significant focus on Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands. What you'll do Build Material Bank's founding portfolio of mobility interior brand partners across automotive, aviation, and marine. Own the full business development lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and developing relationships through negotiation and partnership execution. Represent Material Bank at industry trade shows, conferences, and customer events, building awareness and establishing credibility within the mobility interiors community. Develop trusted relationships with executives, commercial leaders, designers, specification teams, and decision-makers across leading manufacturers and suppliers. Lead consultative business conversations that demonstrate how Material Bank creates value through material discovery, digital sampling, specification tools, and market insights. Partner closely with Product, Catalog, Marketing, and Leadership to shape Material Bank's strategy for the mobility sector, bringing customer and market insights back into the business. Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and emerging technologies that influence the future of mobility interiors. Serve as a trusted industry expert, helping establish Material Bank as the leading platform for mobility material discovery. What you'll bring 15+ years of experience within the mobility interiors industry, ideally in automotive, aviation, marine, or a related materials manufacturing environment. Deep knowledge of the European mobility market, with an established network of manufacturers, suppliers, OEMs, and industry leaders. A proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior executives through credibility, expertise, and a consultative approach. Strong commercial instincts with experience developing new business and closing strategic partnerships. An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business, create opportunities, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy. Exceptional communication skills and executive presence, with confidence engaging customers, partners, and industry leaders. Experience representing organizations at industry events and trade shows. Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 75%) throughout Europe and North America. A passion for innovation and the future of mobility design. It's an exciting time for the company - Material Bank is growing rapidly and expanding the business to Europe with regional headquarters based in Paris, and offices in London and Stuttgart . Candidates who join us will have the unique opportunity to define, build, and shape our European business. Material Bank uses your information to process your current application and offer you job opportunities in the future. Relaxation and Celebrations : Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect). Health Benefits : We contribute to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term disability plans and have a strong employee assistance program. Plan for your Retirement : 401(k) eligible after your first 90 day's employed! Giving Back : We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities. Most importantly, be the best at what matters! title: Staff Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer, Simulation
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Simulation ML Infrastructure team builds scalable AI/ML infrastructure to accelerate the Simulator team in sustainably innovating and building state of the art simulations of realistic environments for the testing and training of the Waymo Driver. To increase the fidelity and steerability of the simulations, we employ large foundation models trained on massive datasets to model the real world, including but not limited to, realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists etc.), roads, traffic control systems, and weather etc.

We seek an experienced Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer to lead the development of advanced AI/ML infrastructure for multi-billion parameter foundation models in ML accelerator-friendly simulations. Your expertise in massive model scaling, ML accelerators, and distributed training will be required for designing and scaling our systems.

This role reports to an Engineering Manager.

You will:

  • Be part of a world-class, high-performing research engineering team to advance the state of the art of ultra realistic multi-agent simulations using foundation models.

  • Collaborate closely with the core Google DeepMind and Waymo Realism Modeling teams in London, and Waymo Oxford to use the large models to improve sim realism.

  • Provide deep technical leadership on large-scale ML model architectures, especially for autonomous vehicle models. Work at the intersection of data engineering, model development, and deployment, and provide guidance on architectural decisions and technical directions. Own large, complex systems, driving architectures that meet technical and business objectives.

  • Design and scale large distributed systems covering the ML lifecycle, supporting planet-scale dataset generation and model training.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to derive performance and system-level requirements for large ML systems. Translate product/business goals into measurable technical deliverables, ensuring system component alignment.

  • Mentor junior engineers, growing their expertise and fostering a collaborative culture.

You have:

  • BS in Computer Science, Robotics, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in machine learning infrastructure such as developing, scaling, training, deploying, and optimizing large-scale machine learning systems from data to model.

We prefer:

  • MS in Computer Science, Robotics, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in machine learning infrastructure such as developing, designing, scaling, training, deploying, and optimizing large-scale machine learning systems from data to model.

  • Solid experience in the development and optimization of machine learning infrastructure tools like DeepSpeed, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.

  • Strong expertise in distributed training techniques, including gradient sharding and optimization strategies for scaling large models across ML accelerator profiling tools to uncover performance bottlenecks.

  • Deep understanding of state-of-the-art machine learning models such as auto-regressive transformers and familiarity with custom-kernels for diverse h/w compute based efficiency.

  • Practical familiarity in Autonomous Driving, Simulations, and ML accelerators is a huge plus.

Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level.  Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

  • Develop and mentor team members, supporting both individual growth and long term organizational capability building.

  • Extensive experience leading structured, stage gate product development programs from concept through mass production launch.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams through complex, multi disciplinary product launches.
  • Comfortable making high stakes program decisions under time and resource pressure.
  • Strong leadership and people management capability, including managing teams across multiple locations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence executive leadership on program status, risk, and trade offs.

Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence. You'll operate at programme level, with visibility across every project within the osteoporosis programme, partnering with the Programme Leader and the Project Leaders who own each individual project. If this sounds like you, and you thrive in matrixed environments and want a real hand in shaping how tomorrow's medicines are discovered, come and join us in the heart of London. Work with functional leads to ensure appropriate resource allocation and to onboard supplementary resources where needed to support delivery. Proactively manage plans, budgets, risks and issues across the programme, escalating to senior management when appropriate. Support leadership in navigating high-impact, high-risk situations with clear analysis, high transparency and a spirit of partnership — even in the face of significant adversity or major obstacles. Translate scientific and strategic objectives into integrated project plans, timelines and milestones. Coordinate execution across the wet lab, ML research, data science and engineering teams, owning cross-team dependencies and prioritisation, and actively monitoring interdependencies across teams as the programme evolves. Comfort managing a programme where scope and workstreams may evolve significantly as science matures from exploratory biology through to a defined lead series. Scientific literacy sufficient to engage credibly with discussions spanning wet lab biology, single-cell omics, and machine learning, and enough grounding in the discovery pipeline (target validation, hit-to-lead, lead optimisation) to track progress and flag risk without needing to do the science yourself. Familiarity with stage-gate or portfolio governance frameworks as applied to early discovery programmes (e.g. go/no-go criteria, TPP evolution, milestone-based progression). Experience overseeing third-party or outsourced work packages (e.g. CROs, academic collaborators, specialist service providers) — tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality against agreed scope, and escalating issues appropriately. PM Technical Specifics Fluency with modern project management methodologies, artifacts and tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Jira; Gantt, RAID logs). Strong organisational skills with a record of managing complex, interdependent works treams in matrixed environments. Comfort with the operational realities of R&D projects Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to write clearly for senior external audiences. The role

As a Support Engineer at Heidi, you’ll apply deep technical expertise to diagnose, resolve, and prevent complex issues in our AI-powered healthcare product.

Your work directly impacts product reliability, customer trust, and Heidi’s ability to scale safely in high-stakes clinical environments. By owning technical issues end-to-end and partnering closely with engineering and product teams, you’ll play a critical role in supporting clinicians, improving patient care, and contributing to the long-term success of our company.

What you’ll do

  • Act as an escalation point for customers and internal team members on complex or technical issues particularly for escalated or high-impact cases.

  • Become a product expert, developing a deep understanding of how Heidi works and how customers use it in real-world clinical contexts.

  • Provide exceptional technical support by clearly understanding customer needs, communicating effectively, and resolving issues accurately and efficiently.

  • Perform in-depth analysis and debugging of complex technical issues, applying sound judgment and care in high-trust healthcare environments.

  • Own customer issues from initial contact through to resolution, ensuring timely, accurate responses within agreed service levels.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to understand, reproduce, and resolve complex technical problems - ensuring escalations are clearly documented well-scoped, and aligned with customer impact.

  • Monitor server health, system status, and bug reports, taking immediate action to mitigate impact, escalate critical issues, and prevent recurring problems.

  • Proactively identify systemic or recurring issues and contribute to improvements across tooling, processes, and systems that increase product reliability, support efficiency, and the team’s ability to scale, including helping identify and address recurring issues.

 

What you'll need

  • 2+ years’ experience in a support engineer role.

  • A proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and enjoys collaborating with an international team dedicated to building impactful AI experiences.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and learn on the fly.

  • Strong customer focus - you excel at and genuinely enjoy helping customers.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to question, clarify, empathise, use appropriate tone and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users in a clear, empathetic manner.

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.
