title: Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About the role

You own the Arcade Design System - the structural layer every product team at DevRev builds on. You'll define how components behave across contexts, how tokens translate intent into implementation, and how a growing design team contributes to a coherent system without fragmenting it. This isn't component art; it's the architecture that makes an entire platform feel like one mind designed it.

What you'll do
  • Own Arcade components end-to-end - from Figma source of truth through token architecture to production, ensuring the gap between spec and shipped product is negligible.
  • Define and maintain the token system (color, spacing, elevation, typography) - making architectural decisions about naming, hierarchy, and semantic structure that scale across themes and modes.
  • Drive Figma library governance - versioning, contribution models, and release cadence so product designers always work from a single, trustworthy source.
  • Collaborate directly with engineers on component APIs, prop contracts, and migration paths. You think in implementation terms.
  • Turn recurring questions into documentation or patterns rather than ad-hoc fixes. Make self-service the default.
  • When three teams solve the same problem differently, propose the unified pattern.
  • Mentor L1-L3 designers on systems thinking through workshops, education sessions, and structured critique.
What you'll bring
  • 5-8 years of product design experience, with significant time in design systems, component libraries, or platform/infrastructure design.
  • Expert Figma skills - advanced component architecture, variants, variables, and library management at scale.
  • Design engineering sensibility: comfort with design tokens, CSS custom properties, and component APIs (React or equivalent). You can review a prop contract as naturally as a Figma frame.
  • Deep understanding of token architecture - not just using tokens but defining hierarchies, naming conventions, and semantic structures that hold across themes, modes, and platforms.
  • Experience working embedded with engineering on component migration, API design, or design-to-code pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to own outcomes, not outputs - you can point to a migration you drove, an adoption metric you moved, or a systemic problem you resolved permanently.

Who you are

  • When you see inconsistency across the product, it's a structural problem you feel compelled to solve.
  • Before adding a token tier or component variant, you can name every context it will appear in and every team it will affect.
  • Before finishing any component, you've considered its prop contract, token dependencies, Figma structure, and migration path as one coherent decision.
  • You treat the design system as a product and its users as your customers. When a designer is stuck, your instinct is to help them succeed - not to gatekeep correctness. You earn adoption through empathy, responsiveness, and genuine care for the people building on your work. The system's success is measured by the confidence others feel using it, and that confidence starts with you.
  • You don't optimize for comfort - you optimize for the platform, even when that means reworking your own earlier decisions as the system evolves.

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

You can expect to:

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

What we're looking for

  • At least five (5) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

About the Role:

Location: Fully remote, with occasional in-person days at Birmingham Hub

Hours: A split shift built around the school day — 9:00am–2:30pm and 5:30pm–8:30pm, with the afternoon free for pickups, appointments, or whatever else needs doing. If you've been ruling out full-time roles because nothing fits around your kids' schedule, this one's designed to.

We're looking for an experienced Business Travel Consultant to join our Birmingham-hub team on a shift pattern that actually works around family life. Same great role, work, just split across the day so you're free for maybe the school run without giving up full-time hours or pay.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle travel bookings, amendments, and cancellations for business travellers with a focus on quality service

  • Arrange European and domestic travel including flights, car rentals, and hotels

  • Manage client communications via live chat, phone, and email

  • Work autonomously on client enquiries and maintain GDS queues

  • Mentor junior team members and quality-check their work

  • Develop client relationships throughout the travel lifecycle

Required Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of Galileo or Amadeus GDS systems, including ticket reissuing

  • Proficiency in air fares and ticketing

  • Previous business travel consultant experience

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)

  • Strong organisational skills and ability to work under pressure

  • Professional telephone manner and client-facing confidence

  • Comfortable managing a split-shift routine and picking work back up mid-evening

Desirable Qualities

  • Proactive problem-solving approach

  • Flexibility and willingness to support team needs across both shift blocks

  • Positive attitude toward colleagues, suppliers, and customers

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Working Hours & Conditions

  • Working hours are flexible to accommodate school picks up during the day.

  • Role will be fully remote however you will be required to come into the Birmingham Hub for training and special events.


Interview Process

GDS Test - Online
Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Team lead + Team manager interview - 90 Min virtual
Final interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

title: Student QA Engineer (Working Student)
description:
About Keyfactor 

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Student QA Engineer (Working Student)

Department: Engineering / Quality Assurance

Location: Aachen, Germany

Working Hours: Up to 19 hours per week

Employment Type: Student Employment

 

Position Overview

Keyfactor – PrimeKey Labs is seeking a Student QA Engineer to support the Engineering and Quality Assurance teams in ensuring the quality, reliability and correctness of our security and PKI-based products. The primary focus of this role is on test case design, manual test execution and product understanding, with the opportunity to explore test automation as familiarity with the systems and workflows increases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and understand product features, technical requirements and user workflows.
  • Design, document and maintain structured and traceable test cases.
  • Perform manual test execution and record results, defects and observations.
  • Collaborate with development and product teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria.
  • Identify and document test cases suitable for future automation.
  • Support the development and maintenance of automated tests using TypeScript and related tools as applicable.
  • Maintain QA documentation, test reports and related internal artifacts.
  • Assist with hardware interaction and test environment setup and validation.
  • Support OAB (Operational and Automation Backend) maintenance and related quality assurance activities.
  • Participate in testing and validation of PKI and security-related workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT Security or a related field.
  • Understanding of basic software testing principles and quality assurance processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured working approach.
  • Ability to document work clearly and consistently.
  • Willingness to work across testing, documentation and technical support tasks as required by product needs.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Flexibility is supported in coordination with team and academic commitments. #LI-NA1

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with any programming or scripting language, TypeScript is an advantage.
  • Interest in cybersecurity, PKI or cryptographic systems.
  • Basic experience with test management or defect tracking tools.
  • Basic knowledge of automation tools or CI systems such as Jenkins.

Working Model

  • Up to 19 hours per week during the academic term.
  • Primary in-office days are Wednesday and Thursday at the Aachen location.
  • Flexibility is supported in coordination with team and academic commitments.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience.  

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits 

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.  

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees. 
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology. 
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts. 
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays. 
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development. 
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings. 

Our Core Values 

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.  

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.  

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY  

We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.

Based in Cologne, you will be a key player in the Engineering team working on the IMPECT family of applications. You’ll contribute to IMPECT’s internal services that power our data ecosystem, sourcing and managing data from external providers, ingesting and recording video content, and enabling large-scale event collection and annotation. You’ll also help build and evolve the systems that support our data collection workforce, including tools for task assignment, progress tracking, deadline management, quality assurance, and accurate compensation. In addition, you’ll develop database-driven tools that ensure consistency and detect anomalies, safeguarding data quality when integrating multiple data sources. IMPECT’s applications are written in modern frameworks and provide exciting challenges. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you’ll be part of a highly motivated team building and evolving the core services that power our data collection platform, forming the foundation for the applications we deliver to our customers.

We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance.  Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Build and maintain Angular web applications
  • Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications
  • Design and implement database schema
  • Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications
  • Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.
  • Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features
  • Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.
  • Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • At least 5 years of software development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin or Java.
  • Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema
  • Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications
  • Experience with Git code management is highly desired.

Other Requirements:

  • Very strong attention to detail.
  • Proven self-starter.
  • Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to prioritise and a “can-do” attitude.
  • Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability 
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better.  There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

.

The world needs more protein than ever - not just protein that's better for the planet, but protein that performs better. We stand at the start of that shift, and we intend to lead it through precision fermentation.

Formo is the biotech protein engine for food and nutrition, starting with enhanced casein. Casein is our first hero ingredient, and it's already winning on its own merits: better functionality than animal-based casein. Sustainable, and simply better protein. And it's only the start. We're building the engine behind it: the data, the science, the speed to keep producing the next generation of high-performance proteins.

We partner with the world's leading food and nutrition manufacturers to bring these ingredients to market at scale. From our home base in Frankfurt am Main, a team of entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators drawn from across the globe is doing the work that decides what food is made of next. Our vision? Join us in the start of the performance era of food!

Analytical Testing

  • Perform routine HPLC-UV analyses according to established SOPs

Documentation & Quality

Instrument Management

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Why you’ll love it here

    • Diriger et accompagner la pratique fonctionnelle et technique du Data Stewardship au sein d'une verticale dédiée.
    • Réaliser des formations techniques et méthodologiques auprès des Data Stewards, Data Owners et producteurs.

    • Contribuer à définir les standards d'excellence métier et évaluer le niveau d'expertise lors des recrutements de la filière Data Governance au sein des domaines.
  • Animer et faire grandir la communauté des Data stewards : 
    • En tant qu'expert référent, mentorer et coacher les Data Stewards moins expérimentés (Level 1 & 2) pour les faire grandir sur les pratiques de gouvernance opérationnelle. 


CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Leadership & Influence : Tu cultives des relations solides et basées sur la confiance avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs internes et externes, en gérant de manière experte les attentes et en favorisant l'alignement sur les objectifs stratégiques. Tu fais preuve d'une forte capacité d'influence sans autorité directe, navigues efficacement dans les dynamiques organisationnelles et géres ta hiérarchie de manière proactive. Tu escalades les enjeux critiques de façon stratégique et en garantis la résolution.

  • Expertise Métier & Gouvernance : Tu maîtrises les concepts de Data Governance, Data Quality Management, Data Lineage et Data Knowledge.
  • Solide Compréhension Technique :

Au sein du domaine "Downstream Replenishment", notre collectif a pour mission de concevoir et de transformer les produits numériques qui optimisent la disponibilité de nos produits sportifs dans le monde entier. Composée de Product Managers, Data Scientists et Data Analysts, notre équipe fait le pont entre la tech et le business pour relever un défi de taille : acheminer le bon produit, au bon endroit, au bon moment, grâce à l'IA et aux modèles de données avancés.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Stagiaire Product Manager, tu rejoins une équipe agile. Ta mission principale sera de prendre en charge le déploiement international de l'un de nos produits numériques clés auprès de nos entrepôts et magasins.

Tes responsabilités principales :

  • Soutien au Déploiement et à la Scalabilité du Produit : Participer activement au déploiement opérationnel de notre solution de supply chain à l'échelle internationale et aider à son industrialisation.
  • Accompagnement au Changement : Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe pour accompagner les utilisateur·ices finaux·les (Supply Planners), faciliter l'adoption du produit et co-animer des sessions de formation.
  • Appui au User Discovery : Contribuer à recueillir les retours qualitatifs et quantitatifs du terrain pour aider l'équipe produit à enrichir la roadmap et à optimiser les fonctionnalités futures.
  • Suivi de la Performance : Aider à la mise en place et à l'analyse des indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs) liés à l'adoption du produit et à l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Vie de l'Équipe Agile : Participer activement aux rituels de l'équipe (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, rétrospectives) pour s'imprégner de la culture agile.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité curieuse, orientée solutions et dotée d'un excellent relationnel.

  • Formation : En cours de Master (Bac+5) en école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou équivalent universitaire.

  • Compétences relationnelles & Soft Skills : Capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques pour des profils business, esprit d'analyse et autonomie.

  • Appétences : Un fort intérêt pour les défis de la Supply Chain et la tech.

  • Langues : Anglais courant indispensable (contexte international quotidien). Le français est un plus.

Note importante : Si tu n'as pas d'expérience dans le sport mais que tu es passionné·e par les défis de la tech et de la supply chain, ta candidature a toute sa place chez nous !

 

STACK TECHNIQUE

  • Outils de gestion de produit & Agile (Jira, Confluence)

  • Outils d'analyse de données (Looker, SQL ou équivalents sont un plus)

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (coaching sur mesure, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

  • Immersion dans notre culture sportive (accès aux clubs de sport internes, tests de produits).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de tous niveaux de compétences à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

  • Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payment Squad
description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. Your Mission We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Payment Squad. They manage BlaBlaCar’s payment solutions that provide reliability, trust, and a smooth end-to-end experience. As a Senior Backend Engineer, your role will be to drive the delivery of a reliable and scalable platform that supports the full payment lifecycle, fraud fight, and compliance requirements. You will take ownership of complex, cross-functional projects—such as finalizing the implementation of our payment orchestrator—and play a key role in expanding BlaBlaCar's business by proposing and integrating tailored payment methods for our various operational countries. You will act as a technical reference, demonstrating strong autonomy, deep architectural thinking, and the ability to synchronize with multiple external teams (Legal, Cash Management & Finance, Payment Ops). You will be reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager and working closely with a team of Software Engineers and a Product Manager. Your responsibilities Drive and deliver transverse and complex technical projects from design to deployment, demonstrating a deep understanding of technical constraints and implementation challenges. Lead the finalization and scaling of the payment orchestrator and integrate new, adapted payment methods across different countries. Take a step back to proactively propose platform improvements, task automation, and better observability (e.g., establishing SLO reviews with SREs and owning your monitoring and alerting stack). Interact closely with various teams (Legal, Finance, Fraud/Payment Ops) to synchronize efforts, gather requirements, and assess cross-team impacts. Act as a mentor and guide for mid-level (IC3) developers within the squad, elevating the team's overall engineering standards. Participate in a cyclic on-call duty (approximately 1 week every 7 weeks) to ensure the high availability of our critical payment systems. Your qualifications You have 5 to 10 years of overall engineering experience. You possess deep technical autonomy and a high level of critical thinking regarding software architecture and constraints. You are fluent in Java and have advanced knowledge of frameworks such as Spring, or SpringBoot. You have hands-on experience with service-oriented architectures, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring solutions (Datadog). We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

Nozomi Networks is seeking a Regional Marketing Manager for our EMEA region. This role is responsible for developing and implementing regional go-to-market (GTM) strategies with an emphasis on field and channel marketing, partner collaboration, campaign activation, events, and demand generation. In this role, you’ll work closely with the broader Marketing organization (e.g. Corporate, Product, Global Campaigns, Partner Marketing, and Customer Marketing), regional Sales and Partner teams to build regional marketing plans, promote brand awareness locally, and help execute ABM / demand generation programs to fuel high growth revenue in the region. Channel marketing experience and campaign orchestration are a must.

As a Regional Marketing Manager you will be responsible for developing the Go-to-Market plan for your assigned territories to drive demand, with a strong focus on channel marketing strategies that scale and leverage the partner ecosystem effectively.

In this role you will: 

Be accountable for deploying integrated marketing campaigns and lead generation programs that support key regional initiatives. You’ll work closely with regional sales, partner, and the broader marketing team to meet pipeline targets. Channel marketing knowledge is critical to ensure effective execution with our partner ecosystem.

You will be responsible for tracking results and reporting on campaign success and deliverables.

This role requires strong motivation, collaboration, resourcefulness, and the ability to deliver results through cross-functional alignment and communication. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with startup experience, capable of thriving in a fast-paced, channel-driven environment.

  • Own the overall Go-to-Market plan for your assigned territories with input and expertise from key internal stakeholders
  • Partner with marketing, sales, and partner team to deliver and accelerate pipeline to meet and exceed revenue goals
  • Implement demand generation campaigns in your aligned regions in conjunction with sales and partners to reach buyers and drive demand
  • Serve as liaison to Sales team, be their advocate and conduit to the larger organization

title: Principal Customer Success Manager
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Principal Customer Success Manager 

So, what's the role all about? 

Our Principal Customer Success Managers are the face NiCE CX puts in front of our most valuable customers and partners – the people who can walk into a boardroom, read the room, and change how a conversation is going within minutes. This is a role for someone who thrives on relationships, backs their own instincts, and isn’t afraid to lead from the front. 

You’ll take ownership of some of our most strategic, high-value, and high-complexity accounts, becoming the one person a customer or partner turns to when it matters most. Programme delivery, governance, and technical execution sit with our specialist teams – your job is to be the constant thread that keeps the customer’s priorities, expectations, and experience front and centre, whatever is happening behind the scenes. 

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to sit behind a desk managing a queue of tickets. It’s for someone who wants to own outcomes, influence at the highest levels, and be trusted to make the right call under pressure. 

You’ll work closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and every team working behind the scenes – not to do their job for them, but to make sure their work lands in a way the customer genuinely feels and values. Interaction with customers spans phone, email, chat, and video, with regular face-to-face engagement where it counts, and travel to be in the room for the moments that matter. 

How will you make an impact? 

  • Be the single, unmistakable point of ownership for our most strategic accounts – the person customers and partners trust to make things happen 
  • Walk into any room – boardroom, business review, executive briefing – and hold it, adapting your style to the audience and the moment 
  • Build senior relationships that go beyond the day-to-day, becoming a genuine trusted advisor to VP and C-suite stakeholders 
  • Translate everything our programme, governance, and technical teams are delivering into language and value that customers and partners actually care about 
  • Bring real curiosity about new technology and AI-driven capability, learning quickly enough to speak with credibility about what’s coming next 
  • Balance sharp commercial acumen with genuine customer advocacy – protecting NiCE’s commercial interests while never losing sight of the customer’s success 
  • Spot risk and opportunity early, and know when to bring in the right people rather than trying to carry everything yourself 
  • Lead high-stakes conversations around renewal, growth, and expansion with confidence and commercial rigour 
  • Influence and raise the bar for those around you, cross-functionally, setting the standard for what great customer success looks like 
  • Own the story – usage, adoption, ROI, and what’s next – and tell it in a way that lands with senior stakeholders 
  • Travel to be in front of customers and partners when it counts, because some relationships are only really built in person 

Have you got what it takes? 

  • A track record of genuinely thriving in high-pressure, high-visibility customer or partner relationships – you don’t shy away from the big room 
  • Significant experience in customer success, account management, or a similarly senior customer-facing role, ideally within contact centre, SaaS, or telecommunications environments 
  • A strong, magnetic personality – people remember you, trust you, and want you in the room 
  • Genuine comfort with technology and a real appetite for learning new tools and capabilities, without needing to be the expert in the room 
  • Sharp commercial instincts, with the ability to balance customer advocacy against commercial reality 
  • The confidence to operate independently, make judgement calls, and take ownership when things get complicated 
  • Outstanding communication skills – written, verbal, and, most importantly, in the room 
  • Experience managing multiple senior stakeholder relationships at once, without losing quality anywhere 
  • A genuinely collaborative approach – you know when to lead and when to bring in the specialists who make the outcome happen 

You will have an advantage if you also have: 

  • Previous experience in a contact centre, CCaaS, or similar customer experience environment 
  • A natural interest in AI, automation, or emerging technology, and what it means for customers 
  • Experience influencing programme delivery, governance, or technical teams without formally owning them 
  • A background that blends commercial thinking with genuine customer empathy 
  • Experience operating at executive level with enterprise or key strategic accounts 

What’s in it for you? 

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where some of the best people in the industry come to work. As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn, grow, and make a genuine mark, with career opportunities across roles, disciplines, and locations. 

If you’re ambitious, you back yourself in the room, and you want to be the person our biggest customers and partners can’t imagine working without, you may just be our next NiCEr.

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

title: HR Director, US, Europe & Meta
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

 

A personal note from Andreea, Global Head of HR

I'm Andreea, Global Head of HR at OPSWAT. OPSWAT is also the kind of place where opportunities tend to find the people willing to take them on. Things move fast, there’s always something new to figure out, and you get a lot of space to make an impact. For me, HR works best when it can move at the pace of the business — close enough to understand what’s really going on and quick enough to make a difference. I don’t see that as a formula, though. I’d love to shape what it looks like together with someone who shares that mindset, but who will also bring their own perspective and challenge my thinking along the way. If this sounds like the kind of team and environment you’d enjoy being part of, I’d really love to hear from you.

 

The Position 

The Director, Human Resources for Europe, META (Middle East, Turkey, and Africa), and the US, is a Senior Leadership role reporting directly to our Global Head of HR (Human Resources) and acting as a trusted partner to leadership across all three regions. 

This is not a maintenance role. It is a build-and-scale opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a global cybersecurity company grows, leads, and engages its people. 

You will lead the HR function across 20+ countries, manage a regional team of HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition Business Partners and People Operations, and own the people strategy for a business expanding on every front. If you are energized by turning potential into performance, and you want to work alongside an executive team that values your voice, this is your stage. 

Scope at a Glance 

  • Regions: Europe, META, and the US 
  • Countries: 20+ and growing 
  • Team: HR professionals across Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnering, and People Operations 
  • Reports to: Global Head of HR 
  • Location: London or Timisoara, Hybrid 

Where You Will Be Based 

This is a hybrid role based in either our London (UK) or Timisoara (Romania) office. Both are anchor locations for OPSWAT, and we are open on either — the person matters more than the postcode. You will play a visible part in strengthening in-office collaboration and cultural integration in whichever location you join. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Strategic partnership 

  • Serve as a strategic partner to leadership across Europe, META, and the US, aligning people strategy with business objectives 
  • Translate workforce data into insight that influences executive decisions 
  • Lead workforce planning, organizational design, and leadership development across the regions 

Building and scaling 

  • Build and scale core HR programs that strengthen organizational health, capability, and engagement 
  • Shape HR policies, practices, and systems that keep pace with OPSWAT’s growth, harmonizing where it helps without flattening local nuance 
  • Partner with global HR to deliver a consistent employee experience across the full employee lifecycle 

Regional ownership and compliance 

  • Own employee relations across Europe and META, ensuring fairness, consistency, and legal compliance in every jurisdiction 
  • Ensure labor and employment compliance across 20+ countries, working with local counsel, EOR (Employer of Record) partners, and payroll providers in markets where we hold no legal entity 
  • Navigate the operational realities of the META region, including visa sponsorship, workforce nationalization requirements, and multi-entity structures, in partnership with local HR  
  • Provide strategic oversight of US people programs in partnership with US-based HR resources, who retain day-to-day ownership of US employee relations and benefits administration 

Team leadership 

  • Lead, coach, and grow a regional team of ten focused on speed, accountability, and impact 
  • Coach managers to lead effectively through change, growth, and difficult conversations 

What We Need From You 

Essential 

  • A minimum of ten years of HR leadership experience, including time in a fast-paced global technology environment 
  • Demonstrated ownership of HR across multiple countries and regions 
  • Proven ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution 
  • Strong business acumen and executive presence — you speak the language of both people and performance 
  • A data-driven mindset, with the ability to turn insight into action 
  • Demonstrated success building high-performing teams and leading through transformation 

Strongly preferred 

  • Experience in a company that has scaled through rapid international growth, acquisition, or IPO (Initial Public Offering) preparation 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience 
  • Familiarity with Greenhouse, BambooHR, or comparable HR systems 

How you work 

  • You lead with clarity, empathy, and courage 
  • You bring a sense of urgency, humor, and heart — and a team that will need all three 

 

Why OPSWAT, Why Now 

For more than 20 years, OPSWAT has protected the world’s most critical infrastructure across IT, OT, ICS, cloud, and cross-domain environments. Trusted by governments, industrial operators, and Fortune 500 enterprises worldwide, OPSWAT delivers a prevention-first cybersecurity platform purpose-built for environments where availability, safety, and compliance are non-negotiable. 

You will be joining an organization that: 

  • Is poised for IPO, with global expansion well underway 
  • Invests in AI-driven HR, automation, and leadership excellence

Back End Tech Lead - Funnel Platform

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re hiring a Tech Lead for our Funnel Platform Team.

You will lead the evolution of the shared code, frameworks, and integrations that power our services, build and improve business-critical systems, and shape the technical vision. Your customers are other iwoca engineers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The Team

The Platform team owns approximately 10 shared services that the rest of iwoca engineering builds on top of - including the frameworks and integrations with external data providers (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion, Companies House etc) that underpin our credit decisions. This is not an SRE or DevOps team. Funnel Platform is code and framework focused - building and stewarding the shared services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team works hand-in-hand with other teams to build and deliver a shared vision for the future of the platform.

The Role

The Tech Lead role combines individual contribution, line management, and ownership of the platform roadmap. You will lead a team of developers focused on the shared services and frameworks that other iwoca engineering teams build on, driving technical strategy and translating our long-term vision into robust, maintainable systems.

Your mission is "Making Change Easy" for the engineering teams that depend on you by owning shared services and being the trusted reviewer for contributions from partner teams, ending conflicts between maintenance and delivery through dedicated ownership.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will take full ownership of the team's roadmap and provide direct line management to its engineers.

A balance of delivery, leadership, and influence:

  • Act as a hands-on contributor and lead by example in quality, testing, and performance.

  • Drive the technical strategy and execution for the Platform team, translating vision into well-designed, robust, and maintainable systems.

  • Set direction without a PM - spot the problems worth solving, back them with data, and drive them to delivery.

Architectural ownership and impact:

  • Lead the development of shared frameworks and services that other engineering teams contribute to and build on.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders in the commercial funnel teams to build a shared roadmap.

  • Own the health of the shared services other teams depend on - spotting emerging issues, reviewing contributions from consuming teams,

  • Shape architectural improvements to the shared services over time - measured on developer experience, service health, and reliability, not feature throughput

Team leadership and management:

  • Manage and mentor engineers, taking responsibility for their performance, coaching, and career development.

  • Define and champion engineering best practices within your team and across the wider engineering group.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience developing and owning shared back end services that other engineering teams contribute to and depend on - being the trusted reviewer for their contributions and shaping how they build on top of your work.

  • Experience building and shaping distributed systems in complex business domains.

  • Advanced proficiency in software development.

  • Confidence to work closely with partners from other disciplines to challenge assumptions and discover underlying problems.

  • Demonstrable leadership skills: you have mentored juniors and inspired teams to deliver cross-functional projects. You can balance hands-on coding with strategic planning.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow—whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

Bonus:

  • A strong numerical or technical background, ideally with a degree in physics, engineering, maths, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience with Python, Django, or PostgreSQL.

  • Familiarity with data analytics or machine learning processes.

  • Experience with complex data architectures, including event-sourced data models.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 - £120,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to take Intelligent Acceptance to its next order of magnitude—increasing the scale, breadth and merchant value of the optimizations we make. Your immediate goal will be to improve merchant profit by increasing acceptance and reducing payment costs, using fraud risk to decide when a payment should—or should not—be optimized. We are looking for a systems thinker who can turn competing objectives and fragmented capabilities into a clear strategy that teams can act on. Bring the portfolio together around a shared strategy, roadmap and set of product principles. Decide how we balance acceptance, payment cost and fraud risk at payment and merchant level. Prove and grow the value Define how we measure incremental merchant value across the portfolio. Build experimentation and causal measurement into how we develop, launch and improve products. Own the portfolio’s product economics, including investment cases, adoption strategy and input into packaging and pricing. Partner with Commercial, Finance, Product Marketing and Customer Success to make the value clear to merchants and bring new capabilities to market. Shape Product and Data Science together Co-own the Data Science roadmap and outcome metrics with the Data Science leader. Direct investment toward data and model capabilities that create measurable merchant impact. Set a high bar for explainability, monitoring and safe rollout in high-volume payment environments. Lead the team and portfolio Lead, coach and develop Product Managers across the optimization suite. Give teams clear ownership, goals and decision rights while building a strong shared purpose. Create an effective operating model with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics and Design. Align teams and senior stakeholders around evidence-based priorities, investment choices and trade-offs. Built a practical path toward merchant-configurable optimization. Developed a high-performing team of Product Managers with clear accountability across the suite. What we’re looking for Essential Deep experience in payment optimization, with strong knowledge of acquiring, authorization performance, routing and payment economics. A track record of setting strategy and delivering outcomes across multiple related products or teams. Proven success leading and developing Product Managers. The ability to bring clarity and structure to complex, ambiguous problem spaces. Strong quantitative judgment and experience using experimentation, measurement and financial analysis to make decisions. Credibility with Engineering and Data Science teams working on decisioning or optimization products. Commercial judgment and the ability to connect technical capabilities to merchant value, adoption and sustainable business outcomes. Clear, persuasive communication with merchants, teams and senior executives. We care more about the scope of the problems you have solved and the outcomes you have delivered than a fixed number of years in a particular title. Valuable, but not required Experience building ML-driven decisioning, routing or personalization products at scale. Knowledge of fraud scoring, risk controls and the trade-offs between fraud exposure and payment performance. Experience with causal inference, multi-armed bandits or other adaptive optimization approaches. Familiarity with card-network economics, interchange, scheme fees, retries and stored-credential payments. Experience shaping packaging, pricing or value-based commercial models for technical products. How we work This role is based in Amsterdam or London and follows Checkout.com ’s hybrid working model. Gap Assurance: Evaluate the mapping of financial crime typologies against active transaction monitoring coverage to independently identify and escalate potential tracking gaps to senior management. 2. Independent Compliance Challenge & Assurance Framework Segmentation & Calibration Challenge: Provide independent, 2LoD challenge to data-driven customer segmentation methodologies executed by the First Line (1LoD), verifying alignment with merchant risk profiles. Compliance Oversight in Tuning & Optimization: Review and evaluate the methodologies, statistical testing parameters, and documentation for periodic "Below-the-Line" (BTL) and "Above-the-Line" (ATL) testing performed by the First Line to ensure robust governance. Residual Risk Opining: Formulate independent compliance opinions regarding residual risk acceptance, providing formal advisory input to governance forums and the Global MLROs. 3. Governance, Risk, & Reporting Model Risk Governance: Participate in the compliance review of TM systems and model validation exercises, independently assessing the transparency, logic, and regulatory defensibility of detection models against applicable guidance (e.g., FCA guidance on model risk management). Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with cross-functional stakeholders across lines of defense to communicate compliance requirements and support the adherence to established TM standards. Data Integrity & Alert Lifecycle Assurance Data Lineage Assurance: Review documentation regarding data lineage, integrity, and completeness for feeds ingested into the monitoring architecture to ensure compliance with regulatory standards. raw.title: Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the team

Checkout.com is building the infrastructure that will allow merchants to be discovered, transacted with and paid through AI agents.

Agentic commerce is moving quickly from concept to production. AI platforms, card schemes and merchants are developing different protocols for discovery, cart, payment, identity and consent. No standard has won, and merchants should not have to rebuild their commerce stack for every new platform.

We are looking for a Product Manager to help make Checkout.com the layer that connects this ecosystem. This is a 0→1 role in a new product area with live merchant and platform activity, a growing inventory API, ACP and UCP work, and a roadmap that will extend across discovery, cart and payment.

What you will own

  • Define and execute the product strategy for Agentic Commerce, balancing what merchants need now with the infrastructure that will matter as the market develops.

  • Turn a fragmented protocol landscape-including ACP, UCP, Visa and Mastercard agent programmes, and emerging trust and intent standards-into a coherent, protocol-agnostic product experience.

  • Build the next stage of the product: live catalogue and inventory feeds that make merchants discoverable across AI surfaces, followed by the right cart and orchestration capabilities.

  • Extend Checkout.com’s payment strengths into agentic flows: delegated credentials, authentication, agent identification, consent, risk decisioning, approval performance and dispute evidence.

  • Work directly with AI platforms, schemes, merchants and internal commercial teams to understand real integration requirements and turn pilots into repeatable products.

  • Own the product details end to end: APIs, developer experience, merchant onboarding, operational controls, reporting, commercial model and launch readiness.

  • Lead cross-functional delivery with Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Partnerships, Marketing and Sales. Make decisions, resolve dependencies and keep work moving.

  • Explain complex technical and regulatory questions clearly to engineers, merchants, partners and senior leadership.

What success looks like

  • Merchants can integrate once and reach multiple AI surfaces as their protocols mature.

  • The first agentic merchants go live quickly, with a clear path from pilot to repeatable onboarding.

  • The inventory and payment experiences are reliable, observable and simple for developers to use.

  • Agentic transactions have the controls and signals needed to protect merchants, improve approval rates and handle disputes.

  • Checkout.com has a differentiated position based on merchant value and payment performance-not just a list of protocol integrations.

  • The roadmap is grounded in evidence: merchant demand, usage, approval value, integration effort and commercial potential.

Skills and experience

  • Strong product management experience building merchant-facing infrastructure, platform or API products. Experience in payments is highly valued.

  • Working knowledge of card payments: authorisation, tokenisation, PSP/acquirer flows, wallets, 3DS/SCA, risk and schemes.

  • Curiosity about AI agents and how they use tools, permissions, mandates and payment credentials. You do not need to be an AI researcher, but you do need to understand the implications for commerce and payments.

  • Evidence of owning an ambiguous 0→1 problem and taking it from customer discovery through launch and iteration.

  • The judgement to separate table stakes from genuine differentiation, and to change direction when the market or evidence changes.

  • Comfort working with external partners and senior stakeholders. You will need to represent Checkout.com, not simply attend the meeting.

This role is a good fit if

  • You are comfortable being early, technical and commercially accountable at the same time.

  • You can move between a merchant conversation, an API contract, a scheme requirement and an investment case and make each one clearer.

  • It is not a role for someone looking for a settled market, a fully formed roadmap or a narrow feature area. The opportunity is to help define the category while building something merchants can use now.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Thruster CAD and Stress Analyst
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design. Key responsibilities In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope. Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include: During the Design Phase: Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design. Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads. Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints. Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases. Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability. Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis. Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification. Support the definition of test requirements needed to validate analytical models and structural assumptions. Produce and maintain technical documentation of design choices and trade-offs, to a high standard, capturing analysis methods and results as to serve as reference justification for the design. During Manufacturing, Assembly and Test Phase: Support manufacturing and inspection of parts, resolving design or tolerance issues as they arise. Support root-cause investigations of any structural anomaly or test finding, correlating analysis with hardware behaviour. Update and correlate stress models and analyses based on test and inspection results. Support design iterations and upgrades based on test campaign outcomes. What we would love to see from you A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering or similar degrees. Over 1 year of related experience in CAD design and stress analysis of mechanical or structural hardware, ideally in a propulsion, aerospace or high-reliability environment. Strong CAD skills, able to take a part from concept to a fully detailed, manufacturable design. Solid grounding in structural/stress analysis, including hand calculations and FEA (e.g. Ansys, Abaqus, or equivalent). Familiarity with manufacturing processes (machining, additive manufacturing, welding/brazing) and their impact on design and structural performance. Nice to have: CFD experience, for thermal or flow-related analysis of propulsion hardware. Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across departments. Fluency in English. Skills and Behaviours Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks. Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done. Ability to communicate at all levels of the business. Demonstrates behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork. Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.
